release_notes: OLED 2.42 beta build 97, based on stable build 72. Adds right-button release controls: short press snoozes, 3 to 9.9 seconds arms the buzzer, and 10 seconds switches it off. Buzzer confirmation screens remain visible for three seconds, with a solid circle showing when armed. Adds a persistent Web UI buzzer checkbox. Trend data uses a fixed 96-slot circular RAM FIFO, refreshes at boot, appends live readings, detects gaps, performs bounded one-hour repairs, and supports complete four-hour backfill from the Web UI or by holding both physical buttons for two seconds.
